result.description: Cloud accounting platform for small businesses (invoicing, bank reconciliation, payroll, reporting) with a public developer API.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 authorization code (with PKCE for public clients) for multi-org apps. Custom Connections use client credentials for a single org. No API key or basic auth. Official MCP server supports custom connection client ID/secret or a bearer token. Auth-flow detail comes from my knowledge and the MCP README, because the OAuth doc pages did not render.
result.access_detail: New apps default to the free Starter tier (5 connections, 1,000 calls per org per day). The 6th connection needs payment details and moves the app to Core (AUD 35/mo, 50 connections). Above 50 connections needs App Certification (Plus, AUD 245/mo). Above 1,000 also needs a security assessment. Enterprise is price on application. Custom Connections are excluded from the new pricing and stay on existing terms. Pricing figures come from model-extracted page summaries.
result.api_notes: REST/JSON. Families include Accounting, Payroll (AU/NZ/UK), Files, Assets, Projects, Bank Feeds, Finance, and Practice Manager. The Journals endpoint, XPM API and Bulk Connections need a security assessment and start at the Advanced tier. This family list is from my knowledge, because the API doc pages did not render. Webhooks exist.
result.blocker: Free Starter tier caps at 5 connections. Going past 5 needs a paid plan, and past 50 needs App Certification. Sensitive endpoints (Journals) need a security assessment.
